Citymaker.Park.Feature.plaza.Tooltip: A paved square inside the park. Paths lead to its edge; trees keep clear of it.
Citymaker.Park.Feature.pond.Tooltip: A pond between the paths. Permanently lowers the terrain: removing the park leaves the basin.
Citymaker.Park.plazaAt.Tooltip: Where the plaza sits: in the middle, in a corner, against the longest side, or next to an entrance.
Citymaker.Park.plazaSize.Tooltip: Share of the park the plaza covers (12–90 m across). Made smaller when it does not fit.
Citymaker.Park.lakeSize.Tooltip: How much of the open space between the paths the pond may take.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.PlazaSmaller: The plaza was made smaller to fit the park.
Citymaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForPlaza: There is no room for the plaza in this park.
Citymaker.Plaza.Feature.trees.Tooltip: Shade trees in a grid, or green islands with trees.
Citymaker.Plaza.Feature.fountain.Tooltip: A large fountain with seating takes the centre of the square.
Citymaker.Campground.Feature.restrooms.T: Restroom buildings you choose; replaces the automatic facilities.
Citymaker.Roads.Feature.edgeZoning.Toolt: Zones the land along the new streets so buildings grow there.
Citymaker.Pond.Name: Pond
Citymaker.Pond.depth.Tooltip: How far the basin is dug below the water line.
Citymaker.AddOn.Kiosk.Name: Food stands
Citymaker.AddOn.Kiosk.benches.Tooltip: Two benches in front of each stand.
Citymaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.Name: Plaza trees
Citymaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.layout.Toolti: A regular grid of trees, or round green islands with a few trees each.
Citymaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.spacing.Toolt: Distance between trees (grid) or between islands.
Citymaker.AddOn.Restrooms.kiosk.Tooltip: Puts a kiosk next to each restroom.
Citymaker.Place.Issue.InvalidParent: The area is not a valid shape for a place inside it.
Citymaker.Place.Issue.NoRoom: The place does not fit inside the area.
